title: Understanding Fairness-Accuracy Trade-offs in Machine Learning Models: Does Promoting Fairness Undermine Performance?
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to evaluating 'Fairness' and 'Bias' within machine learning models and human decision-making. Fairness is a fundamental component of AI ethics, and the paper introduces and applies a consistency metric to benchmark the ethical performance (fairness) of various models in a real-world application.
